Definition: hamlets of Jair, a region of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Havoth-jair = "villages of Jair"; 1) certain villages on the east of Jordan, in Gilead or Bashan, which were taken by Jair, the son of Manasseh, and called after his name; 60 or 23 or 30 cities in total
